BMW Launches New SUV Model in India

BMW has introduced its latest SUV model in the Indian market. The vehicle is noted for its acceleration, reportedly reaching 100 KMPH in 4.3 seconds. This launch marks the arrival of what is described as BMW's most powerful SUV in India, expanding the luxury car manufacturer's offerings in the country.
